roleNote: An example of what you can build from kit components. Start from it, change it, or ignore it; layout is your choice. Follow `must` (kit look and accessibility); `defaults` are this example's suggestions, change any of them.
copyNote: Not exported from agentic-ds-kit. add copies the source into your app (components/patterns/settings/) with this contract beside it, and the billing-schedule example it uses into components/patterns/billing-schedule/ (kept if you already have it). You own the copies: replace the demo data, drop the sections you don't need, and keep the `must` lines.
intent: Settings pages in the Stage look: Profile, Billing, Team, Notifications and Security, each under a Settings › section breadcrumb on the inset panel of a layout-shell--inset app shell whose SideNav lists the sections; with Billing overdue / loading / error, Team empty and invite Drawer, and Security 2FA off.
must: Use kit components from agentic-ds-kit for anything the kit has; no local cousins (tables, dialogs, rows, rules, charts)
Semantic tokens only (agentic-ds-kit/tokens.css); no raw hex, no primitive --color-* ramps
At most one appearance="solid" mode="primary" Button per view
Do not restyle kit components; change them through their props, slots, and tokens

The section links are in your app's SideNav (a nav landmark) under a Settings group built from SETTINGS_SECTIONS, with the current section marked; below --grid-breakpoint-md they move into the app shell's kit Drawer with the rest of the nav
Stage look: the app shell uses layout-shell--inset (the SideNav on the canvas, this page on the inset card panel); the pattern renders its own <main>, so don't wrap it in another main

Page layout uses kit layout classes (layout-shell--inset, layout-canvas, layout-header, layout-content, layout-split*) and grid / layout tokens; no hard-coded columns, gutters, max-widths or breakpoints
Wrap every labeled input in Field; Switches in a table row get an accessible name that says the row and the channel
Status is a word in a kit Badge (Active, Invited, Paid, On, Off…), never colour alone
Billing charges come from the billing-schedule example (summary mode); do not build a second charges list
An overdue invoice is a kit Alert (danger) that says the invoice, the amount and what happens next; Pay now is then the one solid primary and Upgrade steps away
Delete workspace is a danger action behind a kit AlertDialog; Cancel returns focus to it
Money arrives pre-formatted from your app; label example data as example
defaults: The Stage shell (Paper's second row, the Nistha site's chrome): the app-shell example with className="layout-shell--inset" and a built SideNav on the canvas (brand, search, app rows, SETTINGS · 5 with the sections, account) and the page on the inset panel with a Settings › section breadcrumb and headerActions (Help, the NotificationStack bell)
Billing is the default section; route section from your URL
Profile and Notifications save from a footer bar (Cancel ghost, Save solid primary with ⌘S); other sections act per card
Team's Invite people is the PageHeader primary; the empty Team page moves it into the kit Empty
Invite people opens a right kit Drawer with Email addresses, Role and Message; Send invites is the Drawer's primary
Billing loading shows Skeletons in the same Cards; a load error is an outlined kit Empty with Retry
Security has no solid primary: Update password and Set up are outline, Delete workspace is outline danger
No motion beyond kit overlays (Drawer, AlertDialog, DropdownMenu), which honour reduced motion
snippet: <AppShellPattern className="layout-shell--inset" nav={<YourStageNav sections={SETTINGS_SECTIONS} current={section} />}><SettingsPattern section={section} headerActions={<HelpAndBell />} onSave={save} onDeleteWorkspace={deleteWorkspace} /></AppShellPattern>
